title: Pope will not need therapy after cancer surgery, doctors say

blocks.text: Vatican City, Holy See – Pope Leo XIV will not need therapy following an operation last week to remove a cancerous tumor from his lung, his doctors said in a statement released by the Vatican on Wednesday. Test results showed the 71-year-old’s cancer “was localized” and “a subsequent oncological assessment confirmed that no further therapy is required”, the statement said. Leo, who was only elected last year as the first US pope, told followers on October 11 that he would be having surgery to remove a nodule.
